selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before change (boot identity + pre-change sysctl values)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id a1dc8e25-9492-4e80-81a5-6337330a5f77 and pre-change values (accept_redirects=1, default accept_source_route=1) before writing config

selected_evidence.requirement: ICMP redirects and source-routed packets persistently disabled for IPv4
selected_evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf and applied it; live sysctl output confirms all six relevant keys (accept_redirects, secure_redirects, accept_source_route for all/default) are 0
Reboot command backgrounded with a short delay so the exec call returned 'reboot scheduled' successfully before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart proof via changed boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: First poll (cmd-463c...) still showed old boot_id (reboot not yet triggered), second poll (cmd-aa45...) hit 'connection refused' proving the node was down, third poll (cmd-5d36...) returned new boot_id bd906608-859c-4c79-bd90-c510e135731d and new uptime, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery and persistence of the hardening settings
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, live sysctl values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route (all/default) are all 0, and /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf is present with the correct persistent settings

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== BOOT ID BASELINE ==="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "=== UPTIME ==="
uptime -s || true
echo "=== CURRENT SYSCTL VALUES (before) ==="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route 2>/dev/null || true
echo "=== WRITING PERSISTENT CONFIG ==="
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
echo "=== APPLYING ==="
sudo -n sysctl -p /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf
echo "=== VERIFY LIVE VALUES ==="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
echo "=== DONE ==="
